title: LLM Targeted Underperformance Disproportionately Impacts Vulnerable Users

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (accuracy, truthfulness, and refusal rates) on multiple-choice datasets (TruthfulQA, SciQ) by prepending user bios indicating high versus low formal education.
Measuring changes in LLM response quality and tone by utilizing user bios that simulate native versus non-native (ESL) English speakers.
Comparing model accuracy and refusal rates by prompting with user bios indicating different countries of origin (USA, Iran, China).
Using male and female name variations in user bios during the country of origin experiments to evaluate potential gender-based performance discrepancies.
